name: Books members read
summary: What members are reading. Member ideas in their own words. At most one short, attributed line from the book — never long passages.
slide_pattern: book-card (cover + title + author) → list (3 ideas in the member's words) → cta
extra_voice_rules: Member's own words for the ideas. The book gives the structure; the member gives the voice.
At most one short, attributed line from the book. Never a long passage.
Title and author exactly as on the book cover.
No 'this book will change your life' or 'must-read' framing.
extra_checks: Title and author exactly match the source book metadata.
Any quoted line from the book is short (under 30 words) and attributed.
Every idea in the post is paraphrased from the member's submission, not invented.
